headline: Markets *tumble* as Nifty 50 drops 1.19%
subline: Broad-based selling led to a significant decline.
hero_text: Nifty 50 slides 1.19% amid broad market downturn, IT only bright spot.

why.title: Market Sell-Off
why.desc: No specific catalysts caused the decline.

why.title: IT Sector Shines
why.desc: IT was the only sector with gains.

sector_reasons.Nifty IT: Only sector in green amidst declines.

bonus_text: Despite market turmoil, IT managed gains.
movers_note_gainers: IT stocks like HCL Tech and INFY led the gains.
movers_note_losers: BEL and Shriram Finance took significant hits.
watch_text: Tomorrow, keep an eye on GBP CPI and USD Federal Funds Rate announcements.
lessons: Market declines can occur without specific catalysts.
IT sector can gain even when others fall.
Volatility spikes often occur with market drops.
Institutional flows have a major impact on market direction.
alert_text: Tomorrow, watch for key announcements like GBP CPI and USD Federal Funds Rate.
cta_sub: Catch the market wrap every day with us.
next_text: Tomorrow, the focus shifts to global events like GBP CPI and USD rates.
